common.title: Export Control Escalation
common.line: Chip and model export controls tighten again.

common.title: Narrow Binding Agreement
common.line: The two leading powers reach a limited but real agreement covering some class of AI risk – weights security, autonomous escalation, a class of biological design tools – with verification thin but not absent.

notable.title: Shadow adoption failure
notable.line: Municipal hospitals and grid operators quietly integrate the unrecallable open frontier model into clinical triage and SCADA-adjacent workflows despite HERA guidance, creating an unauthorised shadow dependency that fails or is poisoned at scale.

notable.title: Shadow clinical stack
notable.line: Municipal hospitals and university labs quietly deploy the near-frontier open weights for triage and diagnostics on local hardware, creating an ungoverned shadow clinical stack outside EU procurement and monitoring.

notable.title: Substation sabotage
notable.line: Coordinated physical sabotage of grid interconnectors feeding the two frozen AI factory sites causes multi-day local outages, investigated as anti-data-centre action and widening the freeze dispute into energy security.
